notes: AFSIM v2.9.0 — Advanced Framework for Simulation, Integration, and Modeling (USAF)
Top-level CMakeLists.txt located at afsim-2_9/swdev/src/CMakeLists.txt (not at source_root root)
Source tree uses plugin/extension architecture via wsf_module + wsf_cmake_extension pattern
src/ directory contains only analysis metadata (vx.json) and markdown docs, no actual C++ sources or build files
Core AFSIM libraries: wsf, wsf_util plus tool libraries (util, util_script, geodata, packetio, dis, tracking_filters, genio, profiling, artificer)
Optional extensions discovered dynamically via glob on wsf_module marker files
Build supports both shared/plugin and static configurations (WSF_PLUGIN_BUILD option)
demos/ contains 63+ scenario demo directories covering air-to-air, IADS, space, cyber, EW, etc.
